plan: Drive: from District of North Cowichan, about 71 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Relke Rd, Bell McKinnon Rd, Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy), West Shore Pky.
Park: 48.35982, -123.60928, pull off on Cains Way (paved road). Map links below.

Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).

R1B-grouse-walk-0002.name: 180 m NE of Sooke River
R1B-grouse-walk-0002.pressureWhy: 3.1 km on foot from the nearest parking (estimate).
R1B-grouse-walk-0002.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Trail: Galloping Goose Trail, 3.1 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
6 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Private land 180 m NW: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: sooty (blue) and ruffed only; 5 each (15 each); no open season on Denman Island (page 20)
sooty (blue) and ruffed; Bow Only; 5 each (15 each); no bow only season on the Gulf Islands in MU 1-1 (except Gabriola Island), in zone B of MU 1-5 (Map A12) or on Denman and Hornby Islands (MU 1-6)
No row in the Region 1 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Mountain quail: printed 'No open season on mountain quail'.

plan: Drive: from District of North Cowichan, about 52 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Relke Rd, Bell McKinnon Rd, Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy), Cobble Hill Rd.
Park: 48.49004, -123.71412, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: the Galloping Goose Trail stretch, 3.1 km one way. About 62 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
